$comment: Single source of truth for the Claude Code bedrock profiles managed by claude_switch.
Both `bedrock` (system-defined global inference profiles) and `bedrock-app`
(application inference profiles, resolved from AWS at switch time) are generated
from this table, so the two modes always expose the same model set.
id              Anthropic model ID; used as the modelOverrides key. Dated IDs must
carry the date suffix exactly as the Models overview lists it.
family          Maps to ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_<FAMILY>_MODEL: opus|sonnet|haiku|fable.
rank            Lowest rank in a family wins that family's alias pin. Re-order to
change which version `opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku` resolve to.
bedrock         System-defined inference profile ID used by `bedrock` mode. Swap the
global. prefix for us. here if you need regional routing.
foundationModel Join key that matches a discovered application inference profile to
this row in `bedrock-app` mode (matched on the backing model, not the
profile name, so renaming a profile cannot break the mapping).
longContext     Whether the [1m] extended-context suffix is appended to the pin.
capabilities    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_<FAMILY>_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES. Listing this
variable DISABLES every capability not listed, so each row carries
exactly what that model supports. Verified per model: Opus 5/4.8/4.7,
Sonnet 5 and Fable 5 are adaptive-only and reject thinking.type
'enabled', so they omit `thinking`; Sonnet 4.6 supports low/medium/
high/max but not xhigh; Haiku 4.5 has no interleaved thinking.
